correctness.rationale: The left normed and right product summands make the weighted backward bilateral shift and its inverse continuous. Each fixed-coordinate n-step amplitude Q_{n,k} differs from P_n by bounded finitely many factors. Unbounded sup P forces every nonzero vector to exceed a fixed norm-seminorm threshold eventually; bounded P leaves arbitrarily scaled e_0 with tiny entire forward orbits. The hypercyclicity transitivity criterion uses finite support u and v with T^{n_r}u -> 0 whenever P_{n_r}->0, while T^{-n_r}v->0 coordinatewise on right. Dense-orbit visits to small norm-neighborhoods imply liminf P=0. Full-sequence versions give mixing; mixing necessity uses U near x_0=1 and V with negative-coordinate norm <eps to force P_n<2eps for all sufficiently large n. Alternating negative weights 2 and 1/2 in blocks of lengths 2,4,6,... make products oscillate between 2^{2m} and 2^{-2m}, showing coexistence without mixing. Independent finite symbolic alternating-block exponent checks corroborated endpoints; no finite test establishes the Fréchet dynamics.
